An '''[[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]''' was present on the ''[[Tafanda Bay]]'' above [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] managed to destroy this unit, while raiding the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] armory.
